facts.business: Emmbi Industries Limited manufactures woven polymer products including Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBC), PWS-based packaging, mulch film, leno bags, water storage tanks, and drip irrigation solutions for industrial, agricultural, and consumer markets across 70+ countries.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Avana Drip - a newly introduced irrigation vertical within the Avana portfolio - to be a meaningful incremental contributor to revenue in FY 2026-27

key_risks: Revenue recognition timing and measurement complexities under Ind AS 115
Domestic market price elasticity and competitive pricing pressure
Dependence on export markets for higher margin growth
Inventory optimization and deferred order placements by industrial customers
